start: Any panel page as owner, on a laptop (side menu) and on a phone ('More' page)

user_sees: The top rows first under no heading, then the groups in a fixed order, each with its title; only groups that have a row this person may open
must_not: A heading with nothing under it; a row this role may not open

user_sees: That page
must_not: A page that then says this role may not see it

start: As owner; a browser where storage is blocked (a private window)

user_sees: All groups open again; nothing breaks
must_not: A crash or an empty menu because the folded state could not be kept or read

must_not: A crash or an empty menu because the folded state could not be kept or read

steps.action: Fold a group that has rows with numbers on them
user_sees: The group's title shows one number: the sum of its rows' numbers; none at 0
must_not: A waiting item hidden with no number; a '0' badge

user_sees: The group stays folded after the reload and opens on a tap
must_not: The fold forgotten; a different group folded

user_sees: The group's title shows one number: the sum of its rows' numbers; none at 0

user_sees: The group stays folded after the reload and opens on a tap
must_not: The fold forgotten; a different group folded

start: As owner; what the menu shows to whom on a shared desk browser

steps.action: Look at the menu and, where it shows, the 'Set up your gym' mark
user_sees: Only the rows this role may open; the mark says steps done of all, like '3/8', with a ring filled by that share
must_not: Owner-only rows (money, staff, settings) shown to staff or a trainer; a ring more than full, or '0/0' drawn broken

steps.action: Sign out and sign in as another role on the same browser
user_sees: That role's own rows; the folded groups carry over because they are kept per browser, not per person
must_not: The rows of the person before still listed; a waiting number of a hidden row counted in a group's badge
